references.term: Job title or occupation: can the employer assign different work from the contract?
references.rule_sentence: The employer may not assign work fundamentally different from the contract except temporarily for accident prevention/repair, or with the worker’s written agreement.
references.law_reference: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021, Art. 12; Cabinet Resolution No. 1 of 2022, Art. 13

references.term: Wage: paying the agreed wage on time; the Wage Protection System.
references.rule_sentence: The employer must pay wages on due dates in the agreed manner, and all establishments must pay through the Wage Protection System or other MOHRE-approved system.
references.law_reference: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021, Art. 22; Cabinet Resolution No. 1 of 2022, Art. 16

references.term: Working hours: normal maximum per day and per week.
references.rule_sentence: Normal working hours must not exceed eight hours per day or forty-eight hours per week.
The worker is entitled to annual leave with full pay of not less than 30 days per year of service (or pro-rated for shorter service).
Employment contracts are fixed-term (renewable) and must follow MOHRE-approved templates for the agreed work pattern (full-time, part-time, temporary, flexible, etc.).
references.law_reference: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021, Art. 8; Cabinet Resolution No. 1 of 2022, Art. 10

references.term: Passport and personal documents: can the employer keep them?
references.rule_sentence: The employer may not withhold the worker’s official documents; documents may be held only as needed for residency procedures and must be returned after issuance.
references.law_reference: Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021, Art. 13(2); MOHRE “Know Your Rights” guide (2024)
